build_NoisyOrTopic_stan_model: build a NoisyOrTopic Stan model for probabilistic topic inference using the Gumbel softmax trick
run_format_data_to_stan: run format_data_to_stan to convert an xarray dataset into a Stan-compatible data dictionary
run_extract_data_from_stan: run extract_data_from_stan to convert Stan sample output into an xarray dataset of inferred parameters
run_get_pars: run get_pars to retrieve the list of parameters needed from the NoisyOrTopic inference
run_get_code: run get_code to retrieve the Stan model code string for the NoisyOrTopic implementation
